properties.name: Freewheel metro query/clip boundary
properties.coordinate_order: [lon, lat] (RFC 7946) — the OPPOSITE of canon.yaml's [lat, lon]
properties.note: Single Polygon covering the 5 NYC boroughs + Hudson/Bergen NJ to Nyack/Piermont (9W) + Westchester to ~Peekskill + Rockland + Nassau. Every vertex lies within the metro-bounds guard (lat 40-42, lon -75..-73). This is the QUERY/CLIP boundary, not the routing extent — a self-hosted ORS/Valhalla graph must cover the bbox of ALL stored route geometry, which can extend beyond this polygon.
